name: maintenance_work_order
description: REQ-893 (CMMS slice 1 part 1), docs/cmms/scope-draft.md. One job on one asset card, made from a work request or directly. asset_card_id is a declarative record id of an assets_card checked in code (decision 0076), never a foreign key. org_unit_id is the card's org unit (the scope column). request_id is the record_id of the maintenance_work_request it came from; the foreign_keys entry promotes it to a uuid column with ON DELETE RESTRICT. document_id is the issued maintenance_order document and instance_id its process instance. There is deliberately no status field: the status of an order is derived from its process tasks (REQ-896). work_done, done_by, done_at, closed_by and closed_at are the done and close record (REQ-897).
